just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on C5 and dwells most on C in Shahnaz. The line peaks at Ds5 (612.5 Hz) at 0:55.8. It closes on C5, not the tonic (Ds5 → C5 → Ds5 → Ds5 → Db5 → C5).
